description:
Returns the platform business rules: the real consequences of actions that modify, delete or move resources (e.g., deleting a folder or a funnel sends the videos inside to the trash for 30 days).
Useful before planning such actions, so the advice given to the user matches how the platform actually behaves.
Domains: funnels, videos_and_folders, video_upload, embed_and_share, player_settings, cta_interactions, playlists, drm_watermark, comparisons_ab_tests, lives, shorts, anti_download_and_domains, credits, thumbnails_and_subtitles, trash_and_recovery, analytics, tutor_ai_assistant, webhooks, review_timeline, subaccounts, billing_and_plans, member_get_member, organization_and_accounts.

domain.description: Filter by domain (e.g. 'funnels', 'playlists', 'drm_watermark'). Omit to get ALL rules.
